title: Complete renderInline in Give mdlite nested lists, reference links, and a code fence that escapes

`mdlite` is the repository in this workspace: `README.md` describes what it already does, `src/` holds it, and `test/mdlite.test.js` is its own suite, which passes. Close the three gaps its README names. Everything else it documents stays exactly as it is — the block order, the inline grammar, the `outline` output, the joining of blocks, and the failure wording — and the work spans the block grammar, the inline grammar, and the command. A bullet item may now be indented. Its level is the number of leading spaces divided by two and rounded down, capped at one deeper than the deepest item currently open in the list, and it is appended to the last item of the level above.
